transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

I start projects and assignments full of ideas, but I just can’t seem to follow through and finish things, and it’s already cost me my first job. I'm here because I really need to understand why I can't seem to complete tasks reliably despite my best intentions.
When you were a child or teenager, did you also have trouble paying attention, staying organized, or sitting still at school or home? Or did these problems mainly start later in adulthood?

These issues definitely go back to my childhood, long before middle school. In elementary school, my teachers always wrote on my report cards that I was bright but daydreamed, forgot homework, and talked out of turn. I also remember constantly getting in trouble for losing my worksheets and blurting out answers back then.
Do these attention and impulsivity problems happen in more than one setting, like both at work and at home or in social situations? Can you give one or two examples?

Yes, it definitely happens everywhere, not just at work. At home, I'm constantly losing my keys and wallet, and I've even let credit card bills go past due because I just forget to pay them. Socially, I tend to cut my friends off when they're talking and constantly space out on plans or RSVPs, which makes me feel really guilty.

Have these attention and impulsivity symptoms caused clear problems in your life, such as poor grades, job loss, accidents, money trouble, or relationship conflict? What is the biggest example that stands out?

Yes, they've caused huge problems, the biggest being that I lost my first job at a biotech startup because I couldn't stay organized or meet deadlines. It also made my final-year college projects a massive struggle, and now I constantly let down my friends and even miss credit card payments because I just forget. It's caused so much shame that I've really pulled back from my social life entirely.

When your focus and organization get worse, is that mainly during times when you’re depressed, very anxious, or using alcohol/drugs, or are these problems pretty constant even when your mood is okay? Have there been long stretches when your mood was fine but the attention problems were still clearly there?

These problems are pretty much constant and always there, even when my mood is completely fine and I'm not feeling stressed or anxious. While losing my job definitely shook my confidence, these focus and organization issues have been a steady presence in my life since childhood regardless of how I'm feeling. I also don't use alcohol or drugs, so it's definitely not related to that.
